technical_detail.background: Five Metsera D&O rows remain HOLD with item-42 linked-duty deferral. The sealed contract policy still pins the item-42 shared source to PROFILE keys RIGHTS_SURVIVAL and NO_ADVERSE_AMENDMENT, but those profiles are withheld from the approved inventory, so on-disk full-set Work3 validation fails (Blocker B). D&O Q01 preferred reading treats coordinated linked duties as roles or children on one operative proposition rather than silently omitting them. Dimension-evidence rows for those child profiles were dropped when HOLDs were respected and return only if the HOLD lifts.
technical_detail.why: Five Metsera rows are HOLD, and Blocker B blocks on-disk full-set Work3 validation because the sealed contract policy pins the item-42 shared source to two profiles the approved inventory withholds.

q_rulings: Q01 (AGREED): One independently operative authored unit is one proposition; coordinated elements (survival years, no-adverse-amendment, claim-continuation) are roles or linked children within that proposition — not silently omitted while the parent claims COMPLETE.
